Coverage

Ethereum transactions to verified Base contracts plus the dedicated batch-submission route. User bridge activity is counted where the L1 entrypoint is identifiable. Unresolved helper contracts, dispute-game clones and mixed bridge routes are excluded.

Execution gas divided by 21,000. This compares gas demand, not transaction usefulness.
